result.stdout:
Description:
  Load and validate an existing architecture model and list discovered output artifacts.
  Does not create a starter file or generate output artifacts.

Syntax:
  arqi init [--file <path>] [--help]

Arguments:
  None.

Options:
  --file <path>, -f <path>  Main architecture file (default: main.arq).
  --help                  Display help without executing the command.

Examples:
  arqi init
  arqi init --file architecture/main.arq
  arqi help init
